Name: Asters Fruit Trees as Crops
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: This fruit tree sapling acts just like a crop thanks to JojaCo bioengineering! Matures in 24 days.
Description:
_Short description_

*   This fruit tree sapling acts just like a crop thanks to JojaCo bioengineering!

*   Made specifically for CopperSun to use with her Joja mods. This includes [Joja Immersion](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8586)  and [Joja Seeds](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8746).

*   Also has a less Joja-centric version that's sold at Pierre's.

_Longer description_

*   Because they're like crops the seeds only appear in their season. So for example apple and pomegranate seeds would appear in Fall.

*   Mango and banana trees become available in shops after you've unlocked the Island Trader.
_Configurations_

*   Choose your config based on which file you download. Only download one file!

*   By default the main file makes the seeds purchasable from Joja for several thousand g and you can't walk over the crops. Optional files include an easy mode which reduces the prices and lets you walk through the crops. There is also an option for Pierre to sell the seeds. All crops mature in 24 days and die at the end of the season. Greenhouse use is recommended. Watch out for crows!
_Compatibility_

*   Should be compatible with most mods but was made specifically for CopperSun to use with her Joja mods.

*   Beware the json shuffle if you're adding this to a game that already uses Json Assets. Otherwise it's fine to add it mid-save

*   If you're using SVE you need to use the Pierre version because SVE's Joja works a bit differently and won't work with this mod
_Mods used in the screenshots_
[Terracotta Garden Pots
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4363)
_Fun things
_I have a [discord server](https://discord.gg/YPEN5fg7qG) now! Where I'll post wip art and you can make suggestions for new mods, ask for help, or just chat and show off your farm.  I also do [art and other comissions](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart/gallery).
